reviews.review:
I want to love this game. The concept is great! But: 

-it often times behaves weirdly, like spawning inside the crashe zone and being unable to move for a while, inputs not working right for a time so instead of grabbing my gun I drop something... but it works fine most of the time? Odd...

-Map is mostly empty, which is what you want in this type of game, but playing alone its boring. 

-Unable to join groups. Try as I might, always been playing alone.

- Cam is a bit odd. Not necessarly bad, per say, but takes time getting used to.

>> the whole experience could be massively improved by just being with someone, but I never was able to group up with anyone so... I give up.

There's just something about this game. It's pretty simplistic and modest. Not really a lot going on but everytime I do an escape run I end up having lots of fun and always play for over an hour. Active dev so more content to come!
I would not recommend this game right now because for me while in vr mode the cam is jiggly and i cant seem to fix it if some one knows how to fix it please let me know
reviews.developer_response:
Hey Deadfight, It sounds like the problem is the correct OpenXR driver in Steam not being selected. I've written up a troubleshooting in the forums and you can find the solution for this under Option #3.

Troubleshooting Guide Link:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1376580/discussions/0/3192490867662191548/

If this still doesn't work, I'm happy to personally help you on the Alien Dawn Discord.
